title.narrative: A Path to the Phased Elimination of Malaria from Bangladesh - Bangladesh (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Bangladesh, Malaria, BRAC (BRAC)This program has the following goals: By 2025, reduce malaria annual parasite incidence (API) to less than 1 per 1,000 population at risk in CHT districts, interrupt local transmission and eliminate indigenous malaria in phased manner in 10 other endemic districts, determine malaria-free status of remaining 51 districts.. The objectives of this program are: To achieve and sustain universal coverage by case detection and prompt and complete treatment of all confirmed cases through 2025.. To achieve and sustain universal coverage of population at risk with appropriate preventive interventions through 2025.. To strengthen context-specific surveillance in all malaria settings and outbreak preparedness and response through 2025.. To strengthen program management, monitoring & evaluation, partnership and coordination through 2025.. To strengthen and expand research through 2025.
